calculation_handling.description: States the territorial scope of the By-law: it applies to all lands in the City of Toronto except lands hatched on the Zoning By-law Map as subject to a Former General Zoning By-law. No numeric value is derived from it.

1.5.7(1).explanation: This zoning by-law covers every property in the City of Toronto, except lands shown with diagonal hatching and the name of a former general zoning by-law on the Zoning By-law Map, which stay under that former by-law.
